job.title: Senior Analyst
job.description:
Senior Analyst | Private Clients & Business Advisory

Perth CBD | Full time | Hybrid flexibility

Our client is a well-regarded Perth advisory firm working with a diverse portfolio of private businesses, family groups and high net worth individuals. They’re after a Senior Analyst to join their growing team and play a key role in shaping the financial and strategic outcomes for their clients.

This isn’t a role where you’ll be stuck processing the same thing day in, day out. You’ll get genuine variety, real client exposure and the chance to see the impact of your work on the businesses and families you support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Working closely with a portfolio of private business owners, family groups and individuals, getting to know their structures, goals and challenges
  • Analysing financial information across complex group structures, including companies, trusts and partnerships
  • Preparing financial statements and tax returns, and reviewing the numbers to spot opportunities and risks
  • Providing tax planning and structuring insights that help clients make smarter decisions
  • Assisting with advisory projects such as business restructures, succession planning and growth strategies
  • Liaising directly with clients and the ATO, becoming a trusted point of contact
  • Supporting and mentoring junior team members as you build your own leadership skills

About you

  • Degree qualified in Accounting, with CA or CPA completed or underway
  • 3+ years’ experience in an Australian accounting or advisory firm
  • Strong technical knowledge across tax and compliance for private clients and group structures
  • An analytical mindset and enjoy getting under the hood of a business
  • Confident communicating with clients and building lasting relationships
  • Keen to grow your career in a firm that will genuinely invest in you

What’s on offer

  • Competitive salary package plus bonus opportunities
  • Hybrid working and flexible hours
  • A clear pathway to Manager, with real support to get there
  • Ongoing training and CA/CPA support
  • A friendly, collaborative team where your input is valued
  • Exposure to interesting, varied work and the chance to add real value

If you’re looking for a role with more variety, more client contact and a firm that will back your growth, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Client Services Administrator
job.description:
Client Services Administrator | Tax & Advisory Firm

We’re working with a well regarded tax and business advisory firm in the Perth CBD who are looking for an experienced Client Services Administrator to join their team on a full time basis.

This role is all about the ATO side of things. You’ll be looking after the lodgement program, requesting deferrals, putting in GIC remission requests and setting up payment arrangements for clients. You’ll also deal with client queries, help the accountants and partners where needed and keep on top of general admin.

What you’ll need

  • Experience as a Client Services Administrator in an accounting firm (this is essential)
  • Solid knowledge of the ATO portal
  • Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Confidence dealing with clients over the phone and by email
  • Practice management software experience would be handy

If you’ve got the experience and this sounds like a good fit, apply now or give Faith a call at Kinbridge on 0424 336 058. You can also email faith@kinbridge.com.au for a confidential chat.

job.title: Senior Auditor
job.description:
Senior Auditor | Perth | Public Practice

Our client is a long standing Perth practice with a strong reputation in the local market, built on the calibre of clients they act for. Expect exposure to some genuinely complex, multi entity groups and a large focus on the mining sector. 

What you'll be doing

  • Running audit engagements from planning through to sign off
  • Leading and mentoring junior staff on your jobs
  • Managing your own client relationships (you'll actually talk to clients, not just review someone else's file)
  • Reviewing financial statements and flagging risk areas
  • Having real input into how the team runs its audit process, not just following it

What we're looking for

  • CA or CPA qualified, or close to finishing
  • A few years' audit experience in public practice
  • Solid technical audit and reporting skills
  • Comfortable leading a small team and dealing directly with clients
  • Keen to help junior staff coming up behind you

On offer

  • Full study support through to CA/CPA
  • A real path to Audit Manager
  • Hybrid working, no rigid five days in office
  • Decent systems, so you're not stuck doing manual admin all day
  • Professional development and structured training

This search is confidential, so if you're keen to hear more before committing to anything, reach out to Faith on 0424336058
